ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 20-25 percent high-intensity (white) pixel distribution occurring as radial striae and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity linear striae radiate from the central hinge towards the trailing edges of both lobes; a prominent high-intensity circular blob is located in the lower-central region of the left lobe; a distinct dark circular spot is positioned in the mid-upper region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a deep, narrow aperture and a sharp central vertex; depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile with high-frequency variations along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitudes of serrations range from 2 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave upward curve originating from the median notch and extending to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-texture clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; a singular high-intensity circular spot is present on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes, with higher visibility in the transition zones between light and dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; multiple intersecting linear rake scars visible across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of both lobes exhibit significant structural thickening and irregular silhouettes due to heavy sessile organism accumulation.
